name: Application submission (intake)
rationale: Log description: an application is submitted through a webpage. All three activities are performed mainly by Role_4 (73-100%, step 1 role table), which contains the system user User_1. (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Lead handling (intake)
rationale: Log description: automatic checks after submission. The lead work item is scheduled and withdrawn by Role_4 (99-100%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Handover intake -> offer team to complement the application
rationale: Log description: the application is complemented with information obtained by phone. The concept is created by the intake (Role_4) and the completion work item is started by Role_1 (98%): a handover of work. (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Offer creation and sending
edges: A-Accepted_Role_1 -> O-Create-Offer_Role_1; O-Create-Offer_Role_1 -> O-Created_Role_1; O-Created_Role_1 -> O-Sent-mail-and-online_Role_1
rationale: Log description: if the applicant is eligible an offer is sent by mail. All four activities are performed by Role_1 (98%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Calling the customer after the offer
rationale: Log description: the customer is contacted about the offer. Role_1 performs these activities (98%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Handover offer team -> validation team
rationale: After the offer is received back the call work item is aborted; Role_1 suspends it (97%) and Role_2 aborts it (96%): a handover of work. (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Assessment of the returned offer (validation)
rationale: Log description: after the offer is received back it is assessed. Validation is scheduled, started and set to validating by Role_2 (91-94%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Calling for incomplete files
rationale: Log description: when the application is incomplete, missing information is added by contacting the customer again. Main role Role_3 (55%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)

name: Final decision: denial
rationale: Log description: a final assessment is done; in this log the application is denied and the offer refused. Both by Role_3 (79-80%). (Lifecycle collapsed as in step 1.)
